session.title: Session 8: Infiltration, The Lost Roads & The DC Precinct Vault
session.synopsis: A chronicle of displaced souls traveling the Lost Roads.

editorialForum.summary: Forensic telemetry, active trade-offs, and historical PR change records.

tradeOffs.tradeOffCost: Sacrifices casual OOC table banter & prolonged dungeon exploration in favor of cinematic plot momentum.
Trades casual conversational volume for rich atmospheric grounding and tactile combat blocking.
Trades long-form novelistic breathing room for atomic mobile reader anchors and audio block modularity.

tradeOffs.chosenStance: Preserve Player Action + Grounded Prose Context
tradeOffs.tradeOffCost: Maintains strict table canon & player agency, requiring continuous monitoring against future character leveling retcons.

nearestRisks.title: Emotional Velocity Friction
nearestRisks.risk: High-speed combat transitions in Act I risk rushing party bonding before major emotional payoffs.
nearestRisks.mitigation: Ensure quiet sanctuary/campfire intermissions in upcoming chapters.

nearestRisks.title: Cast Spotlight Asymmetry
nearestRisks.risk: Session 1 introduces Alfie late in Scene 6, tilting early dialogue weight toward Pierre and Dravin.
nearestRisks.mitigation: S2/S3 actively rebalance Alfie's wordcraft dialogue, but new readers experience an asymmetric opening.

nearestRisks.title: Latent Magic Continuity
nearestRisks.risk: Characters exploring mechanics organically at the table risk subtle continuity friction if players later formalize backstories.
nearestRisks.mitigation: Track active ambiguities in CRITIQUE_LOG.md Retcon Watchlist.

changelog.summary: Full novelization from raw audio transcripts with 100% parity verification.

blocks.scene: Chapter 51: The Threat Clocks & The Birthright Boon
blocks.text: “We are running this incursion under strict operational clocks: Prize, Threat, and Hunter,” Naomi warned, laying out the target dossiers. “The objective is a set of temporal handcuffs locked inside the Washington, D.C. police evidence room. But every misstep accelerates the Hunter clock. And the Hunter is Majora—a faceless entity that strips the skin from anyone who gathers historical relics.”
